description: This file implements a command-line based grep wrapper linter that searches for patterns in files, optionally suggests replacements, and reports issues in JSON format. It includes functions for running shell commands, grouping grep output, checking allowlists, and reporting lint messages.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enum class representing severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: NamedTuple class for structured lint message data.

methods.name: as_posix
methods.description: Converts Windows backslash paths to POSIX forward slash paths if on Windows.

methods.name: run_command
methods.description: Executes a subprocess command with arguments, returns CompletedProcess.

methods.name: print_lint_message
methods.description: Creates and outputs a lint message as JSON.

methods.name: group_lines_by_file
methods.description: Groups grep output lines by filename.

methods.name: check_allowlist
methods.description: Checks if a file matches an allowlist pattern using grep.

methods.name: lint_file
methods.description: Processes a file for pattern matches, reports issues, optionally suggests replacements.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function parsing arguments, executing grep, and coordinating linting process.
